reviews.title: Amazing case
reviews.comment: As much as I enjoy the slick aesthetic look it gives out with it’s tempered glass panels while it sits on my desk. Can’t help but appreciate the amazing temperatures that i’m getting from it. While Idle It settles on 32c and while gaming it fluctuates around but always within the 46c range. From previous experiences I call that a massive personally improvement—obviouslymy results will likely be different for you since its likely we do not have the same setup. As for other positives having a USB-C on the front panel is handy to have finally. The case overall feels like an up-to-date PC case for 2026 specially if you’re planning on transitioning or already own DDR5/AM5/DDR7(GPU) hardware. The only cons I can maybe see is if someone is planning on sitting the case on the floor which might feel like a inconvenience due to how the power button is located on the bottom of the case. Other than that is a solid case and a satisfied purchase!
